compact_statement: The 2021 response prioritized restoring services, livelihoods and small-scale fisheries with affected communities involved in choosing activities.

statement: In Nueva Segovia, Madriz and Estelí, the evaluation found improved producer and cooperative capacity, with stronger early resilience gains among participating women.
compact_statement: In Nueva Segovia, Madriz and Estelí, the evaluation found improved producer and cooperative capacity, with stronger early resilience gains among participating women.

statement: Shared resilience systems were only partially institutionalized; sustained support was needed to consolidate achievements.
compact_statement: Shared resilience systems were only partially institutionalized; sustained support was needed to consolidate achievements.

statement: WFP identifies droughts, hurricanes, storms and floods as threats to Nicaragua's food systems.
compact_statement: WFP identifies droughts, hurricanes, storms and floods as threats to Nicaragua's food systems.
uncertainty: Rolling page; no dated causal estimates or nationally representative subnational rates extracted.

statement: Small farmers and vulnerable households in Nicaragua's Dry Corridor face heightened food-security risks from climate extremes.
compact_statement: Small farmers and vulnerable households in Nicaragua's Dry Corridor face heightened food-security risks from climate extremes.
uncertainty: Rolling page; no dated causal estimates or nationally representative subnational rates extracted.

statement: Source dated 2026-04-23 reports: IACHR identifies Nicaragua’s Dry Corridor as 63 municipalities (37% of territory), reliant partly on subsistence/small-scale farming; 2024 El Niño intensified drought and reduced rain, harming crop output and food security.
compact_statement: Source dated 2026-04-23 reports: IACHR identifies Nicaragua’s Dry Corridor as 63 municipalities (37% of territory), reliant partly on subsistence/small-scale farming; 2024 El Niño intensified drought and reduced rain, harming crop output and food security.
uncertainty: No municipal rates or event attribution.

statement: Source dated 2026-04-23 reports: In the Dry Corridor, below-average and erratic rain reduced production and deepened household food insecurity; vulnerable families reduced food quantity or quality and withdrew children from school.
compact_statement: Source dated 2026-04-23 reports: In the Dry Corridor, below-average and erratic rain reduced production and deepened household food insecurity; vulnerable families reduced food quantity or quality and withdrew children from school.
affected_groups: households dependent on agricultural minimum wages
uncertainty: Global food/input price pressures also contributed; household counts are unspecified.

statement: Source dated 2026-04-23 reports: IACHR reports Nicaragua’s 2025 legal changes weakened environmental safeguards and participation or consultation mechanisms in a context of high climate vulnerability.
compact_statement: Source dated 2026-04-23 reports: IACHR reports Nicaragua’s 2025 legal changes weakened environmental safeguards and participation or consultation mechanisms in a context of high climate vulnerability.
uncertainty: IACHR's national rights/governance conclusion; no measured climate-adaptation loss or event-specific causal estimate.

statement: IACHR's 2025 report documents the September 2023 closure of Bilwi/Waspam Indigenous radios serving 17 territories, including channels for reporting violence and climate/environment concerns.
compact_statement: IACHR's 2025 report documents the September 2023 closure of Bilwi/Waspam Indigenous radios serving 17 territories, including channels for reporting violence and climate/environment concerns.
uncertainty: Loss of information/participation channels is documented, not a quantified effect on early warning, preparedness or adaptation.

statement: Source dated 2025-08-25 reports: IACHR reports an armed-settler attack on Mayangna Alal (Sauni As, 30 km from Bonanza, Bosawás) in January 2020: at least four killed, over 16 homes burned, survival goods looted and 79 families displaced.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-08-25 reports: IACHR reports an armed-settler attack on Mayangna Alal (Sauni As, 30 km from Bonanza, Bosawás) in January 2020: at least four killed, over 16 homes burned, survival goods looted and 79 families displaced.
uncertainty: This is conflict-driven displacement and asset loss; the report does not state a climate or weather connection.

statement: Source dated 2025-02-21 reports: SINAPRED announced SINAREM’s launch on 20 February 2025; the system is designed for real-time monitoring, early warning and response to disasters including floods.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-02-21 reports: SINAPRED announced SINAREM’s launch on 20 February 2025; the system is designed for real-time monitoring, early warning and response to disasters including floods.

statement: Source dated 2026-09 reports: WFP’s 2024–2029 plan commits to integrated disaster-risk management, nutrition-sensitive social protection and school feeding linked to smallholder resilience, especially for women and climate-adaptive farming capacities.
compact_statement: Source dated 2026-09 reports: WFP’s 2024–2029 plan commits to integrated disaster-risk management, nutrition-sensitive social protection and school feeding linked to smallholder resilience, especially for women and climate-adaptive farming capacities.
